info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Balonne River to Surat, Balonne River at Warkon and Balonne River at Surat
info.description:
Moderate flooding is expected along the Balonne River to Surat.
The Balonne River at Warkon is currently at 7.87 m and rising, with minor flooding. The Balonne River at Warkon is expected to exceed the moderate flood level (8.00 m) Thursday afternoon. The river may reach around 8.30 m Friday afternoon, with moderate flooding.
No observations are currently available for the Balonne River at Surat. Based on the nearby Surat TM gauge, river levels are estimated to be above the minor flood level (5.00 m) and rising. The Balonne River at Surat may reach around the moderate flood level (7.00 m) overnight Friday into Saturday. Further rises are possible as upstream flows arrive.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
